query:
SELECT mr.id AS "id!", mr.title AS "title!"
                FROM movie_references mr
                WHERE (cardinality($1::uuid[]) = 0 OR mr.library_id = ANY($1))
                  AND mr.title ILIKE $2 ESCAPE E'\\'
                ORDER BY LOWER(mr.title) ASC, LENGTH(mr.title) ASC
                LIMIT $3
